{{Quote|You see, Anise&hellip; that canister may have been ''empty'', but it ''did'' carry ''hope'' for the people of Hitaka.|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], to [[Anise I'Zak]]|<ref name="Chain of Command" />}}
'''Hitaka''' was a [[Farm/Legends|farming]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], with a lush landscape of [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] was [[Mission on Hitaka|sent]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to Hitaka to complete a task. Sidious then arranged for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to engage in a battle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to make it easier for his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to move about unnoticed.<ref name="Chain of Command" />
